question_cn: 哪些棋子能够实施透视攻击？
question_en: Which pieces can deliver an X-ray attack?

options.text_cn: 只有后和车，因为它们走直线
options.text_en: Only queens and rooks, because they move in straight lines

options.text_cn: 后、车、象——所有走直线或斜线的棋子
options.text_en: Queens, rooks, and bishops: all pieces that move along ranks, files, or diagonals

options.text_cn: 只有后，因为它是最强的棋子
options.text_en: Only queens, because they are the most powerful pieces

options.text_cn: 马和兵，因为它们的走法特殊
options.text_en: Knights and pawns, because they move in special ways

explanation_cn: 透视攻击需要棋子沿直线或斜线看穿中间棋子。后（横竖斜）、车（横竖）、象（斜线）都可以实施透视攻击。马和兵的走法不是射线型，无法实施透视攻击。
explanation_en: An X-ray attack follows a straight line through an intervening piece. Queens can attack along ranks, files, and diagonals; rooks along ranks and files; and bishops along diagonals. Knights and pawns do not attack along such lines, so they cannot make X-ray attacks.
